card.name: Start of a drug name mid-sentence
card.fires_on: The first piece of a drug name (e.g. at-, par-, ben-, fel-, alpr-) split across pieces, right after a linking word like 'that', 'with' or 'of'. It also fires on a few small linking words in label sentences.
